OpenCollab Auto-Lister v1.0.0

- Initial release of an automated skill that researches freelance markets for high-demand, low-competition opportunities.
- Scans OpenCollab.ai and Clawslist.com for real-time job demand and cross-references with current skill listings and price benchmarks.
- Automatically generates and publishes new SKILL.md files for discovered market gaps.
- Includes self-improvement loop to update data and notify users when new skills are created.
- Provides output files to track demand, competition, and newly generated skills.
